summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for expenses module on public URL. All requested expense workflows passed (create cash/check/transfer, uniqueness, deductions/net, search modal, edit/delete, role permissions, print-hide classes, ObjectId-safe responses). Auth playbook hardening checks still fail.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts; valid admin login still succeeds immediately.
No application auth HttpOnly cookie is issued; token-only JSON response flow is used.

minor.issue: Preflight returns access-control-allow-origin: *; does not enforce explicit allowed origins for credentialed auth posture.
ensure_default_admin exits early if admin exists, so changed ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD is not reconciled to existing admin.

action_items: Implement failed-login counter + lockout/backoff policy in /api/auth/login.
Add server-issued app auth cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite) or supported secure session mode.
Replace wildcard CORS origin policy with explicit environment-managed origins.
Make admin seed idempotent for password reconciliation when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes.
Optional maintainability: split backend/server.py monolith into smaller modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Expense endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id in API responses and no ObjectId serialization issues were reproduced.
bcrypt implementation uses bcrypt.hashpw (produces $2b$ format), but broader auth hardening requirements remain unmet.
backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>1600 LOC), increasing regression risk.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 expenses+auth checks in iteration file; cleanup/seed tests passed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested expense flows passed in final run on public URL)

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used admin/Admin@123. Temporary UI users TEST_view_exp_ui16 and TEST_manage_exp_ui16 were created then cleaned.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_* expenses and TEST_* users during regression; cleanup test removed them and verified removal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://interest-calculator-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Expenses feature set is functionally working end-to-end (card visibility, page access, cash/check/transfer validations, deductions/net, search modal, edit/delete, role-based UI + API behavior, print hide classes). Remaining open items are auth-hardening/CORS posture from playbook checks.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: /api/auth/login has no persistent failed-attempt tracking or lock window; repeated failures do not alter subsequent successful login path. RCA-2: auth session is token-in-body + localStorage model; backend does not issue dedicated app HttpOnly session cookie. RCA-3: CORS middleware/runtime currently allows wildcard origin in preflight, not strict explicit-origin policy expected for hardened credentialed flows.
